nuggets.text: Nittany Lions coach Matt Campbell spent summer 2022 coaching a sixth-grade softball team, and it won the championship game.
Nittany Lions QB Rocco Becht is the son of Anthony Becht, a former NFL tight end.
Rocco Becht followed coach Matt Campbell from Iowa State, where his 26 wins as a starter led all active FBS quarterbacks.
Matt Campbell was 32 and the youngest head coach in FBS when Toledo promoted him in 2011.
The Nittany Lions are the only FBS team with a shutout in each of the last six seasons.
The Nittany Lions' 45-0 win over Marshall was the third-largest margin ever in a Penn State head coach's debut.
Matt Campbell played defensive line at Mount Union and was twice named an All-American.
The Nittany Lion, adopted as the mascot in 1907, is a mountain lion named for nearby Mount Nittany.
Koby Howard caught six passes for a career-high 161 yards in the Nittany Lions' 45-0 opener against Marshall.
The Nittany Lions and Temple meet for the first time since 2016, when Penn State won 34-27.
